title: Rate-limiter interaction with KV-cache warming causes burst overcharge on cold reconnects
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Intermittent customer-visible overcharges observed for short reconnect bursts that trigger KV cache (prefix) warming. The gateway performs provisional crediting during rate-limit acceptance based on the assumed (warmed) execution path. The runtime may execute the first N tokens on a cold path (larger kernels / higher cost) while warming local KV/prefix caches asynchronously. Reconciliation currently appends the cold-path delta after the provisional credit, leading to mismatches and apparent double-counting or unexplained invoice deltas for reconnect flows. Impacted flows: resume reconnects, short prompts after idle windows, websockets with resume tokens. Goal: ensure provisional credits and final billed cost align deterministically for reconnects with minimal latency and low implementation risk.
